correctness.rationale: For all integers a>=3 and b>2a, the weighted principal terms x^a,y^b,z^b have degree ab with weights (b,a,a), while xz^(b-2) has strictly higher weight ab+b-2a. The Jacobian generators form a parameter regular sequence and have ordinary colength (a-1)(b-1)^2 by Weierstrass reduction. In R/m^(b-1), every first syzygy is Koszul; multiplication by the x-derivative has image dimension r=binom(b-a+2,3). For the perturbation the z-derivative introduces one independent leading term xz^(b-3), while multiplication relations kill all its other contributions in this truncation. Consequently the three-generator image ranks are 2r versus 2r+1 and mu_(b-1) differs by exactly minus one. The smallest explicit values 200 and 199 were recomputed. This strict defect is not inferred from the finite runs alone.
